parseAndDisplayRules.normalGrouping: odds_group_id + match_stage; all concrete options remain in groupOddsList.
parseAndDisplayRules.handicapSorting: Split by left/right team identity, order signed lines oppositely, place visible status 1/2 before remaining; rendering order is not a settlement-equivalence proof.
parseAndDisplayRules.totalsSorting: Order over/under values then numeric thresholds and interleave two halves.
parseAndDisplayRules.teamNames: getGroup reads Chinese group_name / English group_short_name / Vietnamese API dictionary; $T1/$T2 placeholders replaced with pos 1/2 team names.
parseAndDisplayRules.optionLabels: tag controls formatting; ou parses >/< for over/under; hdp uses team plus signed value; text selection families use value; crs and acrs use score labels.
parseAndDisplayRules.asianHandicap: parseAhdpValue splits a score-looking prefix before comma into score and remaining value into line; display group includes score.
parseAndDisplayRules.stage: groupToStageList retains raw match_stage and translates through Match.Stage, not a numeric Map.
parseAndDisplayRules.status: showGroup accepts 1/2/5 for presentation. Odds button onClick requires status=1 and no lock; lock shown for status=2 or status=1 and odds<1.01. Presentation state is not execution eligibility.
parseAndDisplayRules.round: matchTitle/streamLeagueName call round.toUpperCase() directly. BO4 display is a source label, not a frontend interpretation of basketball rules.

replayValidation.method: AST-extracted reviewed pure frontend methods replayed in isolated VM with minimal display/helper stubs; no full application execution, network access or order actions.

implications: Use official generic field parsing and preserve all options; the official frontend does not collapse all lines into one pair.

Build changmen cross-venue semantic mapping from API-defined group identity and scope, with official source tables as evidence; the frontend UI is not itself a full cross-venue hedge/settlement mapping.
The soccer table is reusable as a classification reference but its tab categories overlap; do not treat a tab as a unique settlement market type.
Stage labels can be recognized from source even when a market with that stage was not seen in the snapshot; this does not establish the group IDs for unobserved q2/q4/h2 markets.
Official sorting is UI behavior. Hedge pairing must still match exact predicates, signed lines, score context, overtime and settlement rules.
limitations: No official group-ID-to-settlement dictionary was found in these assets; absence is scoped to the nine downloaded current script resources.
Original third-party bundles are retained in ignored tmp_ray_frontend for inspection; evidence records URLs, SHA256 hashes and formatted line locations.
No product code changed; no credentials are included in this report.
